notes.title: Update ver1.1.0
notes.notes: [h1]Update ver1.1.0[/h1][h2]Patch note[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Contents[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Pile up mode[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/956496aefe5d0b3cdf503825f935fe9fe286adf7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Pile up mode has simple rule. Player drop foods onto the foundation instead of pot.[/p][p]Don't let any foods fall, or the game will be over.[/p][p]Additionally, some foods were replaced to new ones to make it more complicated and fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/903446e51f0803c0e79e6bd98415594b14cbf47d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][p]-Changed objects physical behaviors. Therefore, game performance has been improved.[/p][p]-New abnormality "New friend" has been added to abnormality mode.[/p][p]-Added 3 new achievements refers to new game mode.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy cooking![/p][p]theis[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo version Update
notes.notes:
Hot pot game Demo version has been updated.

[list]
[*]Game has been overhauled.
[*]The pot has been changed to cozy one.
[*]The cook hat has been removed from the game. Click a cabinet to get items now.
[*]Added in-game tutorial.
[*]You can use a slingshot on Next foods.
[*]Changing food's size formula has been changed.
[*]Hammer formula has been changed to multiplicative from additive.
[*]Added new item Butterfly wing.
[*]Added new item TNT bomb.
[*]Some items visual has been changed.
[*]Combo bonus formula has been decreased.
[*]Platinum coins effect has been changed.
[*]More...
[/list]
